headline:
Broward insurance rates
just dropped more than
[[20 percent]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: Check your renewal. The market that set your price is gone.

stats.label: Kin Insurance is cutting rates more than 20 percent for new and existing Broward, Miami-Dade, and Palm Beach homeowners.
The share of homeowner claims turning into lawsuits against insurers here fell from 24.1 percent to 2.0 percent since 2022.
Kin also raised its maximum insurable home value to $14 million and added four new discount programs.
